integrity: The finite claim is supported by explicit code witnesses and a standalone exhaustive verifier using two channel-ball implementations and a sound coloring-bound maximum-clique search. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the binary either/or channel and lengths \(1\le n\le7\); it does not cover simultaneous deletion-plus-transposition errors or lengths \(n\ge8\). A residual originality risk remains for unindexed finite tables or unpublished computations.
title: Exact initial profile for binary one-\(0\)-deletion-or-adjacent-transposition codes
